description_en: Calls the CreateDrdsAccount operation to create an account with read and write permissions for a database
description_zh: 调用CreateDrdsAccount接口创建数据库的读写权限账号
kebab_example: aliyun drds create-drds-account --drds-instance-id drdsusrzimk20000 --db-name testdb --user-name testaccount --password 'Test!123' --api-version 2017-10-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDrdsAccount

parameters.help_en:
The database name.

If DbName is left empty, all databases in the instance are retrieved. If the instance does not contain any databases, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

如果DbName为空则获取实例中所有数据库，如果实例没有任何DbName，产生报错
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the account that has read and write permissions on the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库拥有读写权限账号的名称
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the account with read and write permissions
parameters.name: password
